O.outcome_detail: full battery of cognitive-function measures in healthy older adults

cells.quote: According to RM MANOVA computed for each group separately (Table 2), significant changes occurred only in participants without dementia.
cells.note: The healthy older-adult group showed a significant pretest–posttest change; no randomized comparison condition was used.

D.treatment: 8 sessions of GRADYS VR-based cognitive training

O.outcome_detail: full battery of cognitive-function measures in older adults with mild dementia

cells.quote: In the group of older adults with mild dementia the changes were not significant, however the observed power was low, in turn the effect size was high.
cells.note: The result is inconclusive rather than evidence of no effect because observed power was low and the mild-dementia sample was small.
